Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 01-Jan-2026 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  SEVENTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE MAKEUP EXAMINATIONS - JANUARY 2026  
  CMOS mixed signals VLSI design [ECE_4445]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                     Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                 Explain the nonidealities which affect the mixed signal design in VLSI.                                (4)  
  
  
  A)                                                         Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)            Explain with diagram each block of mixed signal design.                                                (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)            Illustrate the effects of junction capacitance on switched capacitor design.                           (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
2)                 Design a logic to generate two non-overlapping clock signals has state sequence of 11-10-01-00.        (4)  
  
  
  A)                                                         Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)            Explain the working of parasitic sensitive discrete time integrator .                                  (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)            Calculate the equivalent resistance of 5pf capacitor sampled at 1 Mhz clock frequency                  (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3)                 Find the number of input combinations, values for 1 LSB, and the full-scale voltage generated for a    (4)  
  $$3-bit, 8-bit, and 16-bit DAC, assuming that Vref= 12 V.$$  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)            Calculate the differential nonlinearity of the 3-bit nonideal ADC whose transfer curve given in figure (3)  
  3B. Assume that Vref= 5 V and ideal step width =1LSB. Draw the quantization error, Qe, in units of  
  LSBs.  
  
  
  Page #1

Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)       Design a 3-bit Flash converter, listing the values of the voltages at each resistor tap, and draw the   (3)  
  transfer curve for Vin= 0 to 5 V. Assume Vref = 5 V. Construct a table listing the values of the  
  $$thermometer code and the output of the decoder for Vin =1.9V, 2.5V, and 4.1V.$$  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
4)            Design a 3-bit charge-scaling DAC and find the value of the output voltage for D2D1D0= 011 and          (4)  
  110. Assume that Vref= 5 V and C= 0.5 pF.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)       Explain the working of PLL with neat diagram.                                                           (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)       Explain the operation of PLL as frequency synthesizer.                                                  (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
5)            Design a first order switched capacitive filter circuit.                                                (4)  
  
  
  A)                                                      Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)       Define antenna effect? How to avoid Antenna effect during layout.                                       (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)       A 5um/40nm MOSFET biased at 1mA exhibits a transconductance of 1/100 ohm . If the sheet                 (3)  
  resistance of the gate polysilicon is equal to 30ohm/square, what is the widest finger that the  
  structure can incorporate while ensuring that the gate thermal noise voltage is 1/5th of the gate  
  referred channel thermal noise voltage?  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"
